milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the red nether brick wall structure (centered at ~7,1,6 spawn-relative) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it. Target is the center of the structure, max_distance=5 ensures intentional navigation (structure is ~7.8 blocks from spawn), facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the lime terracotta arch (centered at ~-6,1,4 spawn-relative) and face toward it, confirming visual identification. Target is the center of the arch, max_distance=5 ensures intentional navigation (structure is ~6.4 blocks from spawn), facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because mining mossy_stone_brick_wall with a pickaxe drops the block as an item into the player's inventory. The iron pickaxe is provided in the scene, and mossy stone brick wall drops itself when mined. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks.

Uses inventory_has because mining polished_andesite_slab with a pickaxe drops the block as an item into the player's inventory. The iron pickaxe is provided in the scene, and polished andesite slab drops itself when mined. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks.
